cpos.reason: APCOA Germany publicly confirms charging availability and direct/app/RFID/roaming access, and multiple German APCOA location pages identify ad-hoc QR charging, but neither the official German location pages nor the current German FAQ expose the charging price. Exact DE*ACO EVSEs at Norderstedt and Dresden are publicly identifiable, yet current direct/ad-hoc price is still reported as unknown. Public web searches for German APCOA QR/Charge Assist/GreenFlux station pricing did not reveal a reproducible unauthenticated station tariff endpoint. Austrian APCOA prices are explicitly location-specific and must not be imported into Germany. Keep DE*ACO visible but unranked until an exact German QR/app/backend tariff can be reproduced.
cpos.unblockRequires: A public German APCOA station/EVSE tariff payload from the QR/app/backend, or a current official German tariff table that can be scoped safely to DE*ACO.

cpos.reason: Multiple current DE*IPG station records expose exact EVSE IDs and confirm ad-hoc/app/web access, but the direct price remains unknown. The only current machine-readable prices found for DEIPG are eMSP roaming tariffs (for example Kia Charge Business and Mercedes-Benz charging) and therefore cannot substitute for the physical CPO direct/ad-hoc price. No official public tariff table or reproducible unauthenticated station tariff endpoint was found after official-domain, exact-EVSE and aggregator searches. Keep DE*IPG visible but unranked.
cpos.unblockRequires: A reproducible public DE*IPG direct-payment tariff per EVSE/station, or an official IP Innovative Power own-network tariff proven to apply to the physical CPO layer.
